2026 has 261 Mon–Fri days. Statutory holidays (Mt. 102 §) on weekdays: 1 Jan (Thu), 3 Apr Good Friday, 6 Apr Easter Monday, 1 May (Fri), 25 May Whit Monday, 20 Aug (Thu), 23 Oct (Fri), 25 Dec (Fri) = 8 (15 Mar, Easter Sunday 5 Apr, Whit Sunday 24 May, 1 Nov fall on Sunday; 26 Dec on Saturday). Official swaps: rest days Fri 2 Jan, Fri 21 Aug, Thu 24 Dec, worked Saturdays 10 Jan, 8 Aug, 12 Dec — net zero for a Mon–Fri plant (3 days off, 3 Saturdays worked). 261 − 8 − 3 + 3 = 253 days × 24 h = 6,072 h.
